messages:
Priya: Proposal: add a "Cost provenance" tile in the Console that lets an engineer click a heatmap cell and see the chain: route -> prefetched model(s) -> which invocations consumed the KV/prefix credits -> final billed token delta. Use-case: find routes that are accidentally consuming shared prefetch credits and pushing up marginal unit cost. Screenshot mock: https://img.redwood.dev/prov/tile.png :mag:

Priya: Key interactions: 1) click cell to open a timeframe-scoped list of sample invocations, 2) toggle sampling rate (1/10, 1/100) inline, 3) show "estimated cost impact" if sticky-routing or fallback were disabled.

Hector: Love the investigatory flow. Two cautions: a) exposing invocation lists risks PII (need redaction), b) quota meter confusion: customers see token spend but quota vs billing mismatch can cause support tickets. We should show a clear badge "billing estimate" vs "quota consumption".

Lin: Telemetry bits: add fields: `prefetch_id`, `prefetch_origin`, `kv_credit_bytes`, `route_choice`, `fallback_reason`. Keep each event lean and rely on the rollup job to materialize chain links. Sampling: emit `sampled=true` and `sample_weight` so we can surface exact invocation samples without huge storage.

Ravi: Aggregation plan: stream events to raw_events table. Rollup job (daily, OLAP) will compute: per-route per-model amortized_cost, marginal_cost_estimate (compute paired invocations where fallback_tag toggled), and a provenance map mapping prefetch_id -> consuming_routes with counts. Proto SQL for provenance map:
```sql
SELECT prefetch_id, consuming_route, COUNT(*) as uses, SUM(tokens) as tokens_used
FROM raw_invocations_sampled
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY prefetch_id, consuming_route;
```
We'll write tiles as JSON blobs to materialized_tiles table keyed by (date, route_bucket). Console fetches tile for UI.

Hector: For the UI I'd like a small "simulation" button when you click a prefetch_id: it should estimate cost delta if that prefetch had been disabled (i.e., those invocations fall back to cheaper model or pay full tokens). This is similar to what we did for canary cost previews.

Priya: Good idea. Simulation math should be explicit in tooltip: show formula and a link to docs. Also we need a "confidence" indicator derived from sample_weight and effective_n.

Lin: On privacy: redact user text and only show hashed invocation ids. We already have a GDPR-safe token in events; reuse that. Also add an org-level opt-out toggle for showing raw invocations in the console.

Ravi: Rollout: alpha behind feature flag `cost_provenance_alpha` available to internal orgs. ETL job will run via infra-schedule slot on MON/WED/FRI for the first month to limit costs. If alpha looks good, increase cadence. Job PR: infra/ETL-502.

ops-bot: console-service: feature flag `cost_provenance_alpha` enabled for orgs: redwood-internal, partner-sandbox. Canary rollout 5% traffic.

Hector: One more: quotas. We should not let the simulation API be used to run repeated ad-hoc queries that count toward customer quota unexpectedly. Gate simulation behind admin perms and/or rate-limit by org.

Priya: Agreed. I'll update the spec with admin-only simulation and the tooltip copy. Target: internal alpha in 10 days. I'll post mockups and the doc link here. Thanks all :clap:
